instruction_for_next_publish: ALWAYS use $env:ZENODO_TOKEN directly in scripts -- NEVER hardcode or manually retype/reconstruct the token string (a single mistyped character causes silent 403s that look identical to a dead/scopeless token). Before publishing: curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:ZENODO_TOKEN" https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/21467733 to verify GET succeeds and state is 'done'. Then: POST https://zenodo.org/api/deposit/depositions/21467733/actions/newversion. See the research skill's Zenodo Credential Protocol section for the full script pattern (scripts/zenodo-create-upload.py + scripts/zenodo-metadata-publish.py).
